name: How long does it take to repair wood fence panels?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair wood fence panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to repair wood fence panels varies based on the scope of the project. A small repair involving a few pickets might be completed in a few hours. Larger repairs, such as replacing multiple panels or addressing significant structural damage, could take one to two days or more. Factors like weather conditions and the availability of materials can also influence the timeline. Frasheski Construction strives to complete repairs efficiently for clients in Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the project scope; small repairs take hours, while larger ones can take a day or more, also affected by weather and material availability.
